subject: PaperTrail evaluation kit & data upload plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@papertrail.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: PaperTrail evaluation kit & data upload plan

Thanks again for the time today, Olivia — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end for the 3-week evaluation you requested. I captured the scope we discussed and a lightweight "evaluation kit" to make the POC deterministic for both sides.

Recap of objectives
- Primary goal: Validate PaperTrail's document summarization pipeline using Redwood inference for extractive QA and summaries at scale.
- Success criteria (high level):
  - 90th percentile generation latency <= 450ms for 512-token requests under the trial load profile
  - Accuracy: F1 >= 0.78 on agreed-upon QA prompt-set (we'll use holdout queries you provide)
  - Cost envelope: <= $X per 1M tokens (we'll confirm after model selection)

What we need from PaperTrail (requested items)
1) A representative prompt set / query log (format: CSV with columns: user_id, prompt_text, context_id, timestamp) — 3k-10k rows preferred.
2) 200 labeled QA pairs for quality validation (if available) or a small human-eval plan we can run together.
3) Note on sensitive data: please flag any PII or regulated records — we will provide an ingest checklist to help mask/remove before upload.

Proposed timeline
- Wed 24 Mar: PaperTrail shares sample files (first 500 prompts + 20 labeled QA pairs)
- Thu 25 Mar: Redwood provides S3 presigned upload + ingest checklist + eval template (attached: redwood-eval-template.csv)
- Mon 29 Mar: Initial run and first-pass quality report
- Wed 31 Mar: Review call to agree on full trial scope / next steps

Ownership
- PaperTrail: Olivia (technical contact) + Marco (procurement)
- Redwood: Karthik (technical onboarding), Marissa (commercial/procurement), me (overall POC lead)

Attachments in this message: redwood-eval-template.csv (csv) — sample rows and required columns.

Immediate asks for you today
- Reply with preferred upload method (S3 presigned, secure SharePoint, or SFTP) and whether you can share the first 500 prompts by Wed 24 Mar.
- If procurement needs a draft statement of work, loop them in and I can send our trial SLA + SOW draft.

Thanks — available all day tomorrow if you want a quick follow to walk through the template.

Best,
Sean
Lead Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@papertrail.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco@papertrail.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PaperTrail evaluation kit & data upload plan

Thanks Sean — really helpful recap and good alignment. Quick responses inline below.

Upload method
- S3 presigned link works best for us. We can also use our secure SFTP if you prefer not to touch our AWS accounts.

Data we can provide by Wed 24 Mar
- First 500 prompts: yes (we'll sanitize PII where possible).
- 20 labeled QA pairs: we'll include 15 now, and the remaining 185 over next two weeks (we have a small annotation batch scheduled).

Procurement
- Looping Marco on timeline; he asked if you can share the trial SLA + SOW draft so procurement can prep internal approvals.

Security/compliance note
- We'll need confirmation that uploaded files will be stored encrypted at rest and we can provide a list of high-risk fields to mask (we'll send that tomorrow).

Two quick clarifying Qs
1) For the eval, are you expecting we include conversational context (user sessions) or single-shot prompts?
2) If we provide logs with user_id hashes, is that sufficient for your matching logic?

I'll send the first 500 prompts this evening.

—Olivia
Director of Product
PaperTrail AI

On Mon, Mar 22, 2027 at 3:02 PM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time today, Olivia — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end for the 3-week evaluation you requested. I captured the scope we discussed and a lightweight \"evaluation kit\" to make the POC deterministic for both sides....

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@papertrail.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PaperTrail evaluation kit & data upload plan

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Olivia. Short answers and next steps below.

Q1: conversational context vs single-shot
- We can handle both. For the first pass, single-shot prompts (one prompt + optional context field) are easiest and fastest. If you have session logs, include session_id and we will preserve context during scoring. Please indicate in the CSV whether the prompt is conversational (session_id present) or single-shot.

Q2: hashed user_id
- Hashing user_id is fine — include a salt indicator column if you can so we know it isn't being truncated in transit. We only need stable identifiers for grouping; they do not need to be reversible.

Secure upload & checklist
- We'll provision a presigned S3 upload link by EOD today. Alternatively, if you prefer not to use AWS, we can accept via secure SFTP — let us know.
- Attached: data-ingest-checklist.pdf (high level masking steps, file layout, and sample PII removal scripts).

Trial SLA / SOW
- Marissa is copied and will send the trial SLA + SOW draft to procurement. Marissa — assigning you to own contract delivery and signature.

Technical onboarding owner
- Karthik will be your technical owner for ingest and evaluation. He'll reach out after the first upload to schedule a 60-minute run-through and to validate the eval pipeline.

Plan for first run
- Fri 26 Mar: Redwood runs the first 500-prompts batch and returns a QA/quality snapshot (latency distribution, top failure modes, example outputs).
- Mon 29 Mar: Joint review to confirm whether we need additional sampling or prompt augmentation for the final 3k test set.

Action items (redwood)
- Provision presigned S3 link (Sean)
- Share ingest checklist + template (attached) (Sean)
- Send trial SLA + SOW draft to procurement (Marissa)

Action items (PaperTrail)
- Upload first 500 prompts + 15 labeled QA pairs by EOD 25 Mar (Olivia)
- Share list of high-risk fields for masking (Olivia)
- Procurement to review SOW (Marco)

Thanks — will follow up with the presigned link shortly.

Best,
Sean
